_about: John Foxe (1516/17-1587): The Acts and Monuments, a new and complete edition, ed. Stephen Reed Cattley, with a preliminary dissertation by George Townsend (London: Seeley, 1837-1841, 8 vols), the full martyrology rather than the abridged 'Book of Martyrs'. Volume numbers read off each title page; vol. 1, with Townsend's dissertation, was issued last (1841). Named john-foxe so the Quaker George Fox cannot collide. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
